headline: Touchstone Partners secures CCI clearance for amalgamation of Go Digit Infoworks with Go Digit General Insurance
sum: The Fairfax Group has obtained merger control clearance from the Competition Commission of India for the amalgamation of Go Digit Infoworks Services Pvt Ltd with Go Digit General Insurance Ltd such that Go Digit General Insurance will be…
detail: The Fairfax Group has obtained merger control clearance from the Competition Commission of India for the amalgamation of Go Digit Infoworks Services Pvt Ltd with Go Digit General Insurance Ltd such that Go Digit General Insurance will be the surviving entity. Touchstone Partners advised the Fairfax Group, Go Digit Infoworks and Go Digit General Insurance on obtaining the CCI clearance. The transaction team consisted of Vinod Dhall (Senior Advisor), Gaurav Desai (Partner), Shruti Bhat (Counsel), and Rakshit Rana (Associate). Attachment PDF CCI Press Release Preview
